policy.purpose: Review a few high-value voice moments; do not narrate every screen or upload source manuscripts.

scenarios.speaker: Project Plateau narrator

voice_profile.delivery: energetic, clear American English with documentary curiosity
voice_profile.must_not_sound_like: a synthetic system prompt, an elderly lecturer or a female character

scenarios.reason: Existing launch-video narration is the one approved voice-heavy surface.

scenarios.speaker: 吴月娘

voice_profile.delivery: lower-mid register, measured pace, restrained household authority and period diction
voice_profile.must_not_sound_like: a coquettish young heroine, customer-service narration or a male voice

scenarios.text: [calm, firm, restrained] 官人，白日欠的话，先在这里说清。
scenarios.reason: One post-input character response tests period diction, restraint and relationship pressure without voicing every scene.

scenarios.speaker: 铁扇公主（罗刹女）

voice_profile.delivery: commanding lower register, clipped martial hostility, controlled anger
voice_profile.must_not_sound_like: 吴月娘的克制持家声线、甜美动漫少女、温和旁白或 a male voice

scenarios.text: [angry, controlled] 孙悟空!你还有脸上我这翠云山?
scenarios.reason: One pivotal confrontation tests character presence without turning every dialogue box into speech.

scenarios.text: [whispering] 别出声。 [excited] 它飞过去了！
Wait. [laughing] That was closer than I expected.
孙悟空 crossed Project Plateau with four glass plates at 18:40.

[measured] The trail leaves the fort, follows the brook beneath the canopy, crosses the exposed basalt shelf, and ends at the glade. Photograph the family only when the adults turn away, then carry every surviving plate back through cover before the light fails.
